title: Wiper fluid guidance and missing rear wiper mentions
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on wiper-fluid guidance and repeated mentions of the sedan lacking a rear wiper, with most fragments too descriptive to support a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention successful wiper-blade replacement and helpful clarification that regular wiper fluid can be used with the vehicle's cleaning system.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly describe customers missing or expecting a rear wiper, low washer fluid, or procedural wiper discussions without an explicit evaluative sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so sentiment evidence is limited.
The cluster includes both wiper/fluid issues and broader 'misses' mentions, and at least some examples are only loosely related to windshield wipers.
Some fragments are descriptive service notes rather than clear customer evaluations.
